WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT convert(NUMERIC(25,5),COUNT(*)) COUNT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),GROSS_GEARING_RATIO)),0) GROSS_GEARING_RATIO_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),GROSS_PROFIT)),0) GROSS_PROFIT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),NET_GEARING_RATIO)),0) NET_GEARING_RATIO_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),NET_PROFIT_RATIO)),0) NET_PROFIT_RATIO_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),PROFIT_INT_DEP_TAXES)),0) PROFIT_INT_DEP_TAXES_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),SG_RECEIPTS)),0) SG_RECEIPTS_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),TANG_FIX_ASSETS)),0) TANG_FIX_ASSETS_tgt

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM 
FROM d360.STG_EDS_CRM_FINANCIALDETAILS WHERE H = 'D'
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM
)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT REPLACE(H,'F-','') COUNT_src
, GROSS_GEARING_RATIO GROSS_GEARING_RATIO_src
, GROSS_PROFIT GROSS_PROFIT_src
, NET_GEARING_RATIO NET_GEARING_RATIO_src
, NET_PROFIT_RATIO NET_PROFIT_RATIO_src
, PROFIT_INT_DEP_TAXES PROFIT_INT_DEP_TAXES_src
, SG_RECEIPTS SG_RECEIPTS_src
, TANG_FIX_ASSETS TANG_FIX_ASSETS_src

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_EDS_CRM_FINANCIALDETAILS WHERE H <> 'D'
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT
, GROSS_GEARING_RATIO_tgt
, GROSS_PROFIT_tgt
, NET_GEARING_RATIO_tgt
, NET_PROFIT_RATIO_tgt
, PROFIT_INT_DEP_TAXES_tgt
, SG_RECEIPTS_tgt
, TANG_FIX_ASSETS_tgt
, GROSS_GEARING_RATIO_src
, GROSS_PROFIT_src
, NET_GEARING_RATIO_src
, NET_PROFIT_RATIO_src
, PROFIT_INT_DEP_TAXES_src
, SG_RECEIPTS_src
, TANG_FIX_ASSETS_src

, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)

INSERT INTO [EDS].[EDS_HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT 
  CAST(COUNT_SRC AS NUMERIC(25,5)) COUNT_SRC
, CAST(COUNT_TGT AS NUMERIC(25,5)) COUNT_TGT
, CAST(GROSS_GEARING_RATIO_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) GROSS_GEARING_RATIO_tgt
, CAST(GROSS_PROFIT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) GROSS_PROFIT_tgt
, CAST(NET_GEARING_RATIO_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) NET_GEARING_RATIO_tgt
, CAST(NET_PROFIT_RATIO_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) NET_PROFIT_RATIO_tgt
, CAST(PROFIT_INT_DEP_TAXES_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) PROFIT_INT_DEP_TAXES_tgt
, CAST(SG_RECEIPTS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) SG_RECEIPTS_tgt
, CAST(TANG_FIX_ASSETS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) TANG_FIX_ASSETS_tgt
, CAST(GROSS_GEARING_RATIO_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) GROSS_GEARING_RATIO_src
, CAST(GROSS_PROFIT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) GROSS_PROFIT_src
, CAST(NET_GEARING_RATIO_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) NET_GEARING_RATIO_src
, CAST(NET_PROFIT_RATIO_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) NET_PROFIT_RATIO_src
, CAST(PROFIT_INT_DEP_TAXES_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) PROFIT_INT_DEP_TAXES_src
, CAST(SG_RECEIPTS_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) SG_RECEIPTS_src
, CAST(TANG_FIX_ASSETS_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) TANG_FIX_ASSETS_src
, FILE_NAME
, INSERT_DTTM
, DATE
FROM CTE12
) pvt

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC
, GROSS_GEARING_RATIO_src
, GROSS_PROFIT_src
, NET_GEARING_RATIO_src
, NET_PROFIT_RATIO_src
, PROFIT_INT_DEP_TAXES_src
, SG_RECEIPTS_src
, TANG_FIX_ASSETS_src
)
) pvt1

UNPIVOT
(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT
, GROSS_GEARING_RATIO_tgt
, GROSS_PROFIT_tgt
, NET_GEARING_RATIO_tgt
, NET_PROFIT_RATIO_tgt
, PROFIT_INT_DEP_TAXES_tgt
, SG_RECEIPTS_tgt
, TANG_FIX_ASSETS_tgt
)
) pvt2
 
WHERE REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') = REPLACE(METRICS2,'_TGT','');
